name: samil-ax-usecase-prioritizer
description: A Codex plugin that converts business process pain points into prioritized AX use cases, PoC plans, risk checks, and executive-ready summaries.

interface.shortDescription: Prioritize enterprise AI transformation use cases and PoC plans.
interface.longDescription: For Samil PwC-style AX consulting workflows: analyze business processes, pain points, data availability, risk, and expected impact to generate an AX use-case portfolio, prioritization matrix, PoC roadmap, governance checklist, and executive one-pager.
